# form.addChoiceField

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Add a choice field to the current form.

```lua
form.addChoiceField(line, rect, values, getValue, setValue)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `line` | FormLine | yes | the line where the field should be added |
| `rect` | Rect | yes | the coordinates |
| `values` | table | yes | table of all possible values |
| `getValue` | function | yes | the function which will return the current value |
| `setValue` | function | yes | the function which will be called on value change |

## Returns

The new field

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
form.addChoiceField(line, nil, values, function() return value end, function(newValue) value = newValue end)
```

- [System tool with a form](../../cookbook/system-tool.md)
- [tool-servo](../../examples/official/tool-servo.md)
